assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code CO-50.
The denial reason was lack of medical necessity.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries is coded I25.10.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0.
The telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to the symptomatic episodes.
The symptomatic episodes are associated with diagnosis code R42.
